adaptations: Rounded source components replaced by straight rectangular prisms.
Source XZ centres and straight axes retained; small out-of-plane twists flattened.
Alternating layers use half the original repeat pitch as display thickness, giving direct face contact.
Prototype width and thickness use recorded stock; outer/seat edges anchored and layers repositioned together.
